open_data_derivation.method: Require the first prospective economic look to contain at least as many complete independent official-date blocks as the entire certified open regular-season Hits evidence available when this boundary was locked.

a_date_block_is_complete_only_if: the date belongs to one frozen evidence era
every scheduled T-4h target has a verified terminal entry receipt
no target on the date has source_error, missing, late, tampered, or conflicting entry evidence
every captured market has a verified exact prestart reference or an explicit non-applicable no-market disposition
every selected research entry has one official MLB final-feed-backed graded, void, or unscored resolution
the independent lifecycle verifier passes for the date
first_economic_look_boundary.incomplete_dates: retained permanently in the operational exclusion funnel and never silently removed; they do not count toward the 56 complete blocks
first_economic_look_boundary.outcomes_before_boundary: official outcomes and settlements may be collected and hash-verified, but capture, ROI, calibration, subgroup, and economic summaries must not be produced or inspected
first_economic_look_boundary.season_end_fallback: If the regular season ends before 56 complete blocks, publish an underpowered descriptive report labeled insufficient evidence; do not authorize wagering.

era_reset_triggers: model source or model version changes
provider or reference sportsbook contract changes
identity, schema, ledger, or evaluation logic changes
any input or bound-file hash changes
protected_invariants: the operational smoke is permanently excluded
no vendor result grades an entry
DraftKings is reference-only in the declared Texas context
each execution product requires its own legal, account, price or payout, acceptance, settlement, return, and uncertainty evidence
the +0.10 capture lower-bound gate and positive net-ROI lower-bound gate are not lowered
